purpose: Frozen B1-B3 manifest for cross-document semantic benchmark round 2. Version 2 preserves the B1 selection and frozen route profile, and adds the denominator-only semantic-cohort gate before any B3 OpenRouter execution. No B4 model result has been read. Any later change after B4 results are read invalidates the run for decision-gate purposes and must be recorded as a new manifest version, not a silent edit.

documentSelectionRule.eligiblePool: PdfA3PopulationScreeningProbe usable set (selected@160 >= 20 AND decisionRelevant >= 15), 76/95 documents
documentSelectionRule.tieBreak: lowest document ID number within the shape's domain folder among the eligible set - no accuracy-based selection
documentSelectionRule.shape4Note: Specified as 'textbook/RFC/technical'; 04_giao_trinh (textbook) chosen over 07_system_generated (RFC) to test generalization into an uninvestigated domain rather than extend the already-deeply-investigated 091/092 RFC family. Confirmed by user, not swapped.

routeProfile.note: Identical to the A2/A2b frozen profile (054/092), applied unchanged - not tuned per document.
routeProfile.promptProfileSha256Source: DocxHeaderExtractor.Core.Pipeline.PdfBlockAnalyst.PromptProfileSha256 - code-derived, recorded automatically in each run's generation.promptSha256 field, not a value this manifest fixes by hand
routeProfile.executionNote: NOT executed by this manifest. B3 runs this exactly once per document, no retry, no tuning, only after B2 gold review is complete for that document.

reviewPacketRule.sourcePopulation: Raw source lines (PdfLine: page + geometry + text), independent of candidate construction/ranking/scope - never sampled from the candidate pool, so a candidate-construction miss cannot silently vanish from the recall denominator.
reviewPacketRule.occurrenceIdentity: page + line geometry + text (same PdfCandidateProvenance.LineId format used throughout A0-A3), never a candidate ID and never canonical-text-only.
headingFields: parent (optional, only if hierarchy is actually being reviewed)

semanticCohortEligibilityRule.metric: reviewed decision-relevant occurrences after model-free candidate, selection, and deterministic-eligibility census
semanticCohortEligibilityRule.ineligibleResult: semantic metric = insufficient cohort; do not call the model merely to produce a number
semanticCohortEligibilityRule.rationale: This is a denominator-meaningfulness rule, not accuracy tuning. It is frozen before any B3 model result for the round is observed.

frozenBy: B0/B1 session plus B2 semantic-cohort gate, before any B3 OpenRouter execution
